title: Cookie Clicker
description: Bake trillions of cookies in Orteil's legendary incremental masterpiece (orteil.dashnet.org)! Click the giant golden cookie, hire grandmas, build factories, trigger Golden Cookie frenzies, and unlock sweet upgrades.
controls: Click giant cookie • Buy Grandmas, Mines, Factories & Upgrades • Switch between Orteil Web & Offline mode in top bar

title: Slope Game
description: The high-speed 3D geometric ball runner! Roll down endless neon slopes, dodge red obstacles, leap across sudden gaps, and test your lightning-fast reflexes as the speed ramps up.
controls: A/D or Left/Right Arrow keys to steer • Space to start

title: Bouncing DVD Logo
description: The legendary DVD Screensaver game inspired by bouncingdvdlogo.com! Watch the neon DVD logo bounce around the screen, change colors, count wall bounces, and celebrate rare corner hits.
controls: Click/drag to fling • Speed, size, trail & sound controls in bottom bar

title: Retro Snake
description: The timeless retro arcade classic. Slither through the grid, eat the apples to grow, and beat your personal high score!
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to move

title: 2048 Classic
description: Slide numbered tiles on a 4x4 grid. When two tiles with the same number touch, they merge into one! Can you reach 2048?
controls: Arrow keys, WASD, or swipe to slide

title: Flappy Pixel
description: Navigate a little bird through endless oncoming green pipes. Timing and gentle taps are everything in this addictive classic.
controls: Spacebar, Click, or Tap to flap

title: Brick Breaker
description: Classic arcade breakout action. Control your paddle, angle your ball bounces, and shatter all colored brick formations.
controls: Mouse, Arrow keys, or Touch to slide paddle

title: Space Defender
description: Defend humanity against waves of alien invaders! Dodge incoming enemy lasers and retaliate with your ship's plasma cannon.
controls: Left/Right keys to steer, Space to shoot

title: Tetris Blocks
description: The world's favorite block puzzle game. Rotate and fit descending tetrominoes into complete horizontal lines to score points.
controls: Up to rotate, Left/Right to move, Down to soft drop, Space to hard drop

title: Classic Pong
description: The legendary 1972 table tennis video game. Play in solo mode against a dynamic CPU opponent or go head-to-head in 2-player mode.
controls: P1: W/S or Mouse | P2: Up/Down Arrow keys

title: Dino Pixel Dash
description: Endless prehistoric desert sprinting. Leap over prickly cacti and duck beneath low-flying pterodactyls as speed accelerates.
controls: Space or Up Arrow to jump, Down Arrow to duck

title: Tic Tac Toe
description: Quick tactical fun on a 3x3 grid. Play solo against the computer or challenge a friend in local pass-and-play mode.
controls: Click or tap any grid cell to place your symbol
